summary: The Division of Highways acknowledged the City's conditional agreement to vacate Sunnyside Avenue and advised that since the School District would receive acquisition funds from the Division, the School District should contact the City directly to work out the vacation arrangement, with the replacement schemes treated as possibilities rather than fixed plans.
text:
This is to acknowledge receipt of your letter of October 15, 1971 relative to the subject highway improvement and in particular to the vacation of Supposide Evenue, adjacent to the Econocett School site.
The suggestion for this vacation, as discussed in our letter of July 0, 1971, was made as a result of our desire to replace the recreational land which the Illinois Division of Righways will acquire from the Roosevelt School site. By presenting these schemes for vacation to the City and the School District, we have attempted to determine the feasi, ility of this land replacement plan. The remainse by the City of Chicago heights has been affirmative regarding this vacation; negative, this is with the understanding that the City will be compensated for this loss.
Since the School District will receive Loney from the Illinois Division of highways for the acquisition of their land, they should have funds to acquire the portion of Lunnyside Avenue adjacent to the school site.
We have informed them of this fact and have suggested that they contact the City disputly if they are surious about such a plan. We feel that the season to choose Sunnyside Avenue should be worked

out between the School District and the City and that the replacement schemes sent in my provious letter should be considered to be only four possibilities out of many.
